ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in the circle $\odot O$. Given that $\angle ADC = 150^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle AOC$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is inscribed in circle O, \\
it follows that $\angle B + \angle ADC = 180^\circ$, \\
Given that $\angle ADC = 150^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle B = 180^\circ - 150^\circ = 30^\circ$. \\
Therefore, $\angle AOC = 2\angle B = \boxed{60^\circ}$.
